description: Orchestrate SDLC workflows end-to-end: task (feature/task/story), change request (cr), and cook (TDD implementation).

evals.name: Task Workflow Routing
evals.prompt: I need to build a new feature: user authentication with email/password login. Start a new feature for this.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator correctly identifies 'feature' workflow type, invokes sprint to pick a TODO task, enters plan mode (or auto mode if --auto), then spawns SRS→HLD→LLD→IMP+TST agents with gate verification at each phase. Output includes clear phase sequencing, gate-verifier calls after each design phase, and parallel IMP+TST spawning.

evals.name: Change Request Workflow Routing
evals.prompt: I need to make a change request: the payment service API needs a new 'refund' endpoint added to the existing REST API. Create a CR for this.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator correctly identifies 'cr' workflow type, invokes sprint to pick a Done/In Review task, enters plan mode to assess HLD and LLD impact, then conditionally spawns HLD→LLD→IMP+TST agents. Output shows understanding that CR workflow has optional phases (HLD/LLD only if affected by the change), always executes IMP+TST, and adds CR task to board.

evals.name: Cook Workflow Routing
evals.prompt: I have a task that's Ready for implementation: 'Add input validation to user registration form'. Cook this task.
evals.expected_output: Orchestrator correctly identifies 'cook' workflow type, invokes sprint to pick a Ready task, enters plan mode to assess BE/FE impact, then runs TDD pipeline (red→green→refactor→gate) for affected layers. Output shows understanding of TDD sequence, gate mode routing (light after green, full after refactor), and parallel BE+FE when both affected.
